title: Designing high-performance infrared optoelectronic materials: indium-site substitution in LiInSe2 with Al, Ga, Sn, and Sb
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,47981-47988
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05215G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jiahuan Chen, Sichen Luo, Yuqing Yang, Yanan Zhang, Suwen Han, Pengfei Lu, Chunlian Xiong, Yue Cheng, Changcheng Chen, Xiaoning Guan
First-principles calculations reveal that targeted doping (Al, Ga, Sb) effectively tunes LiInSe2’s band gap and enhances mid-wave infrared absorption, with Sb in the R3m space group exhibiting exceptional optoelectronic performance.
